sloka: अपराधिषु यो दण्डः पात्यते मानवेषु वै ।स दण्डो विधिवन्मुक्तः स्वर्गं नयति पार्थिवम् ।। ७.७९.९ ॥
transliteration: aparādhiṣu yo daṇḍaḥ pātyate mānaveṣu vai ।sa daṇḍo vidhivanmuktaḥ svargaṁ nayati pārthivam ।। 7.79.9 ॥

translations.english: The punishment that is properly inflicted upon offenders among men, when administered according to law, leads the king to heaven.
